scheme_name: Educational Assistance (Scheme for the Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship to Children of Construction Workers Registered with the MBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a resident of Meghalaya
Beneficiary must be engaged in building or other construction work and be registered with the Meghalaya Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board with active membership
Children of the beneficiary must be enrolled in any grade from Class I to Degree Course
Children must not be receiving any other financial assistance from any source
A maximum of two children per parent/guardian are eligible, applicable to girls as well
Scholarships are not offered for courses with a duration of 6 months or less
Post‑Matric applicants must possess the relevant qualification from a recognized institution and provide the original certificate of study
Scholarship may be cancelled for misrepresentation, change of course or institution without prior approval, or discontinuation of studies
Renewal requires a fresh application each year upon promotion to the next class
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend ranging from ₹400 to ₹800 depending on the class level, with an additional ₹200 per month for blind students and a one‑time grant for books and uniforms.
documents_required: Original certificate from institution of study
